sources: sec edgar submissions api, 8-K item 2.02 acceptance times

event_plausibility.reason: Off 'suspect' to 'unknown', not to fits_cadence. The 'last print' the matcher found on 2026-10-15 is the 8-K pre-announcing preliminary Q3 revenue and cash use, not the results release; the company's own release sets Q3 2026 results for 2026-11-09 with a 16:30 ET call.

amended_from.reason: an event 25 days after the last print does not fit a 70-day cadence; the calendar row may be stale

event_plausibility.amended_by: edge sweep, company-sourced; before any hunter launched

options.event_implied_move_basis: 13.71% straddle over 4 calendar days less 7.22% of ordinary 20d-realised movement, subtracted in variance
options.skew_note: IV(25d put) - IV(25d call). Positive = the market is paying more for downside protection than for upside.

deadband_basis: half the median of 8 prior reactions, floored at 1.5%
deadband_note: A realised move inside this band is scored as no-direction rather than as a miss.
expected_move_basis: option straddle net of ordinary vol, front expiry

baseline_quality.note: thin means there is no reliable statement of what the market priced, so a confident call on this name cannot be justified by the baseline.
baseline_quality.history_discount_note: reaction history is present but not counted toward the tier: the event date does not fit this company's own filing cadence, so the history may describe a reporting regime it no longer follows
